title: Why this seat
intro: Production interfaces in React and Next.js, the events those pages fire, and a Sass codebase that stays coherent with the design spec.

items.title: React and Next.js
items.text: I build the interfaces that ship. JavaScript, CSS, and SCSS sit under that work.

items.title: Design to Sass
items.text: Matching a design spec and keeping a Sass codebase coherent is normal work, not a special project.

items.title: Own the frontend
items.text: Membership and webinar flows, redirect and UTM logic, and GTM dataLayer events. I owned the page, the test, and the events. The conversion readout stayed with the company.
